newsitem.title: USA: PG&E names Glynn CEO, CFO made unit head.
newsitem.headline: PG&E names Glynn CEO, CFO made unit head.

text.p: PG&E Corp said Wednesday that Robert Glynn, its president and chief operating officer, will succeed Stanley Skinner as chief executive June 1.
Skinner, 60, will continue as chairman of the board of PG&E and its largest subsidiary, Pacific Gas and Electric Co, until he retires on December 31, the company said.
Upon Skinner's retirement, Glynn will become chairman, president and chief executive of the corporation and the subsidiary.

Additionally, the company said Gordon Smith, its chief financial officer and the senior vice president and chief financial officer of Pacific Gas and Electric, will become president and chief executive of Pacific Gas and Electric, June 1.
It said a successor to Smith as chief financial officer of the corporation will be named in the near future.
